# Monipay Documentation

> Monipay is a stablecoin payment platform that lets anyone send USDC or USDT to any social media username — no wallet, no gas, no friction. These docs cover MagicPay, MoniBot, smart contracts, supported chains, and security architecture.

Monipay is a gasless, non-custodial payment network built on top of multiple blockchains. It allows users to send and receive stablecoins using human-readable usernames called MoniTags, instead of complex wallet addresses. The platform sponsors gas fees for all users, making it as easy to use as traditional payment apps like Venmo or Cash App.

MagicPay is the underlying technology that enables social media payments. By linking social accounts like Twitter, Discord, or Telegram to a MoniTag, users can receive payments directly on those platforms. If a recipient doesn't have a Monipay account yet, the funds are held securely in an on-chain escrow contract (IOU Registry) until they claim them.

MoniBot is an autonomous AI agent that interprets natural language commands on social media platforms. Users can simply tweet or message @Monipay to send funds, run giveaways, or check their balance. Monipay currently supports Base, BSC, Solana, Tempo, Ink, and Celo, providing a unified payment experience across the entire multi-chain ecosystem.

## For AI Agents
Monipay's core primitive is the IOU Registry (IOURegistry.sol), an on-chain escrow contract that holds stablecoin payments until the recipient claims them by connecting a wallet. The claim flow: sender issues payment via MoniBot command → IOURegistry escrows funds on-chain → recipient visits monipay.xyz, connects wallet, funds released. If unclaimed after the expiry window, the sender can reclaim. MagicPay is the product name for this entire username-to-payment flow. MoniBot is the AI agent that interprets natural language commands inside Discord, Telegram, and X. Key terms: MagicPay, MoniBot, IOU, IOURegistry, claim flow, username resolution, stablecoin rail, gas sponsorship.
